title: Wire Receipt Fee on Retention Remittances
content:
# Wire receipt fee — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the wire receipt fee is part of the retention remittance.

The wire receipt fee is USD 30.00 when the case carries three or more payoff funds receipts sent by wire, recalled ones included, and USD 15.00 when it carries exactly two; a case with fewer carries no wire fee (0.00).

| Wire receipts recorded on the payoff case | Wire receipt fee |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | none |
| 2 | USD 15.00 |
| 3 or more | USD 30.00 |

A wire later recalled still counts as a wire receipt. Receipts by cashier's check are not counted.
